mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no, p.name, p.price, p.discount_rate, TRUNC((p.price - (p.price * p.discount_rate / 100)) / 100) * 100 AS sale_price, p.category_id, p.description, p.use_yn, p.same_day_delivery_yn, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM product p WHERE p.product_no = #{productNo}
SELECT product_img_no, product_no, image_url, image_type, sort_order FROM product_img WHERE product_no = #{productNo} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, product_img_no ASC
SELECT product_option_no, product_no, option_size, color, stock, use_yn FROM product_option WHERE product_no = #{productNo} ORDER BY product_option_no ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_product.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO product ( product_no, name, price, discount_rate, category_id, description, use_yn, created_at, updated_at, view_count, same_day_delivery_yn ) VALUES ( #{productNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{discountRate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{categoryId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, 0, #{sameDayDeliveryYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
INSERT INTO product_img ( product_img_no, product_no, image_url, image_type, sort_order ) VALUES ( seq_product_img.NEXTVAL, #{productNo}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageType}, #{sortOrder} )

INSERT INTO product_option ( product_option_no, product_no, option_size, color, stock, use_yn ) VALUES ( seq_product_option.NEXTVAL, #{productNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{optionSize, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{color, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stock, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
